column1: # Neighborhood -> sub-county lookup for Nairobi listings.
# Method: each neighborhood was geocoded via OpenStreetMap Nominatim
# spatial-joined against Nairobi sub-county polygons from GADM v4.1
# Refined geocoding queries used for ambiguous names:
# Manual override (point fell on a constituency boundary):
#   Dagoretti Corner  -> DagorettiSouth (common usage; spatial centroid fell
#                       in Kibra at the Ngong Road / Naivasha Road junction)
# Excluded: Joska (real Joska is in Machakos county; Nominatims default match
#           returns a place inside Nairobi which is incorrect).
